messages.subject: spline- inference using first derivative
parts:
Dear INLA  Team

I had been working on smoothing using the built in spline in INLA.

Model:   eta=\beta_0+\beta_1*x+f(x)
where I put an improper prior on f(x) that is "Rw2". 

Currently I am interested on the derivative of the regression function eta'. Is it possible to obtain a "prediction matrix" which maps the model parameters to the prediction of linear predictor?
Belay

>

the easiest would be to make linear combinations of the differences of
the linear predictors, and then scale them, like [g(x+h)-g(x)]/h to
get the first derivative. see

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-I-have-some-linear-combinations-of-the-no
des-in-the-latent-field-that-I-want-to-compute-the-posterior-marginal-
of-is-that-possible-
